rationale: Previous candidates progressively reduced kp from 0.7 to 0.6 and softened sensor weights to reduce oscillations and overcorrection, but no telemetry data is yet available to confirm effectiveness. Evaluator feedback recommends further reducing kp to 0.5 and softening sensor weights to smaller magnitudes like [-0.35,0.45,-0.35] if oscillations persist. I also reduce base_speed further to 0.7 to improve stability on complex track sections. Ki is lowered to 0.02 to reduce integral windup and avoid overshoot. Line loss strategy is kept as 'last_direction' since it performed reasonably and to isolate effects of controller tuning. I expect these changes to reduce steering oscillations and line loss events, improving stability and line tracking. The requested measurements include steering_oscillation and line_loss_events to verify these hypotheses in the next telemetry.
